g.text: The selected comparison preserves 10,087 adjusted discharges and 44,371 outpatient encounters

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #687780

g.text: These quantities guide investigation of staffing and procurement practice; they are not automatic budget or workforce decisions.
